## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen design, and why this change belongs in
OpenKratos.

## Compatibility

- [ ] This change does not alter a public API, default behavior, wire format,
      module, tool, or minimum Go version.
- [ ] I updated `COMPATIBILITY.md`, `COMPATIBILITY_zh.md`, and migration guidance
      for every intentional compatibility change.
- [ ] I recorded any upstream PR, issue, and source commit in
      `docs/upstream-adoptions.md`.

Explain any unchecked item:

## Validation

List the exact tests, race tests, integration checks, and benchmarks run. For a
performance change, include the baseline, environment, repeated samples, and
`benchstat` result.

## Review Notes

Call out generated files, external services, release steps, or follow-up work
that reviewers must understand.
